# Water Cleaning Script

## Import Raw Location and Parameter Data

```{python}
import pandas as pd
from pathlib import Path
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
import os
from dotenv import load_dotenv
from sqlalchemy import create_engine

load_dotenv()
```

```{python}
data_dir = Path(os.environ["DATA_DIR"])
water_dir = data_dir / "water"
```

```{python}
values_path = water_dir / "all_water_values.csv"
locations_path = water_dir / "all_monitoring_locations.csv"
parameters_path = water_dir / "parameter_info.csv"
```

```{python}
locations_df =  pd.read_csv(locations_path, dtype = str)
parameters_df = pd.read_csv(parameters_path, dtype = str)
```

```{python}
chunk_size = 200_000
```

## Clean Data


### Find Unique Values

```{python}
#max_chunks = 1
values_output_path = water_dir / "unique_parameter_names.csv"

if values_output_path.exists():
    unique_values_df = pd.read_csv(values_output_path, dtype=str)
    print(f"{values_output_path} already exists, skipping unique-parameter export.")
else:
    all_values = []

    for i, chunk in enumerate(pd.read_csv(values_path, dtype=str, chunksize = chunk_size)):
        #if i > max_chunks:
            #break

        merged = chunk.merge(
            locations_df,
            left_on = "monitoring_location_id",
            right_on = "id",
            how = "left",
            copy = False
        )

        merged = merged.merge(
            parameters_df,
            left_on = "parameter_code",
            right_on = "id",
            how = "left",
            copy = False
        )

        all_values.extend(merged['parameter_name'].dropna().unique())

        print(f"chunk {i} done, moving onto next chunk")

    unique_values_df = pd.DataFrame({
        "parameter_name": sorted(pd.Series(all_values).dropna().unique())
        })

    unique_values_df.to_csv(values_output_path, index = False)
```

### Find Missingness for each unique value

```{python}
missingness_output_path = water_dir / "county_parameter_missingness.csv"

if missingness_output_path.exists():
    print(f"{missingness_output_path} already exists, skipping county-parameter summary.")
else:
    summary_rows = []

    for i, chunk in enumerate(pd.read_csv(values_path, dtype=str, chunksize=chunk_size)):
        merged = chunk.merge(
            locations_df,
            left_on="monitoring_location_id",
            right_on="id",
            how="left",
            copy=False
        )

        merged = merged.merge(
            parameters_df,
            left_on="parameter_code",
            right_on="id",
            how="left",
            copy=False
        )

        merged["time"] = pd.to_datetime(merged["time"], errors="coerce")
        merged["year"] = merged["time"].dt.year

        temp = merged[["county_fips", "year", "parameter_name"]].dropna()
        temp = temp.drop_duplicates(subset=["county_fips", "year", "parameter_name"])
        temp["present"] = 1

        summary_rows.append(temp)

        print(f"chunk {i} done, moving onto next chunk")

    parameter_present_df = pd.concat(summary_rows, ignore_index=True)

    parameter_present_df = (
        parameter_present_df
        .groupby(["county_fips", "year", "parameter_name"], as_index=False)
        .agg(present=("present", "max"))
    )

    county_years = parameter_present_df[["county_fips", "year"]].drop_duplicates()
    total_count = len(county_years)

    county_year_missingness = (
        parameter_present_df
        .groupby("parameter_name", as_index=False)
        .agg(present_count=("present", "sum"))
        .sort_values("present_count", ascending=False)
    )

    county_year_missingness["total_count"] = total_count
    county_year_missingness["missing_count"] = (
        county_year_missingness["total_count"] - county_year_missingness["present_count"]
    )
    county_year_missingness["missing_rate"] = (
        county_year_missingness["missing_count"] / county_year_missingness["total_count"]
    )

    county_year_missingness = county_year_missingness.sort_values(
        "missing_rate", ascending = True
    )

    county_year_missingness.to_csv(missingness_output_path, index=False)
```

We will use the above file to determine the values to use

### Aggregate by Year + County

```{python}
output_path = water_dir / "final_data" /"water_data_aggregated.csv"
processed_chunks_path = water_dir / "final_data" / "processed_chunks.csv"

max_chunks = None

values_to_use = ["Dissolved oxygen", "pH", "Temperature, water", "Turbidity, Nephelom", "Specific cond at 25C", "Phosphorus, wu", "Total nitrogen, wu", "Chlorophyll, in situ", "Suspended solids"]

if processed_chunks_path.exists():
    processed_df = pd.read_csv(processed_chunks_path, dtype=int)
    processed_chunks = set(processed_df["chunk_index"])
else:
    processed_chunks = set()

if not processed_chunks and output_path.exists():
    output_path.unlink()

header_written = False if not processed_chunks else True

for i, chunk in enumerate(pd.read_csv(values_path, dtype=str, chunksize = chunk_size)):
    if i in processed_chunks:
        print(f"Chunk {i} already processed, skipping.")
        continue

    if max_chunks is not None and i >= max_chunks:
        break

    merged = chunk.merge(
        locations_df,
        left_on = "monitoring_location_id",
        right_on = "id",
        how = "left",
        copy = False
    )

    merged = merged.merge(
        parameters_df,
        left_on = "parameter_code",
        right_on = "id",
        how = "left",
        copy = False
    )

    combined_df = merged[merged["parameter_name"].isin(values_to_use)].copy()

    combined_df = combined_df[["county_fips", "time", "parameter_name", "value", "unit_of_measure_x"]].reset_index(drop = True)

    combined_df = combined_df.rename(columns={
        "time": "date",
        "unit_of_measure_x": "unit_of_measure",
        "county_fips": "county_id",
        "parameter_name": "parameter"
    })

    combined_df["date"] = pd.to_datetime(combined_df["date"], errors="coerce")
    combined_df["value"] = pd.to_numeric(combined_df["value"], errors="coerce")

    combined_df["parameter_unit"] = (
        combined_df["parameter"].str.lower().str.replace(" ", "_", regex = False)
        + "_units_in_"
        + combined_df["unit_of_measure"].str.lower().str.replace(" ", "_", regex = False)
    )

    combined_df["year"] = combined_df["date"].dt.year

    aggregated_df = combined_df.groupby(["county_id", "year", "parameter_unit"], as_index = False).agg(
        sum_value=("value", "sum"),
        count_value=("value", "count")
    ).reset_index()

    aggregated_df.to_csv(output_path, mode = "a", header = not header_written, index = False)
    header_written = True

    print(f"chunk {i} done and {len(aggregated_df):,} rows written")
    
    processed_chunks.add(i)
    pd.DataFrame({"chunk_index": list(processed_chunks)}).to_csv(
        processed_chunks_path, index=False
        )
```

### Create Final DF

```{python}
aggregated_df = pd.read_csv(output_path)

aggregated_df = aggregated_df.groupby(["county_id", "year", "parameter_unit"], as_index = False).sum()

aggregated_df["mean_value"] = aggregated_df["sum_value"] / aggregated_df["count_value"]

df_final = aggregated_df.pivot(
        index = ["county_id", "year"],
        columns = "parameter_unit",
        values = "mean_value"
    ).reset_index()
```

# Export to database

```{python}
database_url = os.getenv("DATABASE_URL")
engine = create_engine(database_url)
```

```{python}
df_final.to_sql(
    "water_quality",
    con=engine,
    if_exists="replace",
    index=False
)
```
